description: Render .kerf source to SVG or DXF files, one per sheet, with part sizes, layers and warnings. Uses millimetres and bundled Atkinson font. No filesystem or network imports. Bounded to 100 parts and 10 sheets. For production generators install @mylasertools/kerfscript locally.

libraries.description: Optional virtual libraries keyed by the exact use/include path. No files or URLs are fetched.

source.description: KerfScript program. Lengths are millimetres; angles are degrees.

name: kerfscript_render
